wages.invalidAmounts: Please enter valid amounts — paid cannot exceed agreed.

wages.selfReported: Entries are self-reported by you — they are not verified with your employer.

jobs.title: Job matches
jobs.disclaimer: Listings are published by labour offices on ShramSetu. ShramSetu does not verify the employer or the wage. Never pay a fee to get a job.
jobs.empty: No job matches right now. New listings from your district will appear here.
jobs.unverifiedNote: ShramSetu has not verified this employer or the wage. Confirm the terms in writing before starting work.
jobs.shortlistedNote: The office read your application. This is not an offer of work — keep applying.

review.panelSubtitle: Publish work inside your jurisdiction, then review the workers who apply.
review.unverifiedNote: Listings are scoped to your jurisdiction and marked unverified for workers: ShramSetu cannot confirm that an employer will honour the stated wage.
review.loadError: Could not load your job listings.
review.outsideJurisdiction: That listing is outside your jurisdiction.
review.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Mason required for apartment site
review.descriptionPlaceholder: Work, site, wage payment schedule, working hours
review.employerPlaceholder: Name as workers will see it
review.contactPlaceholder: Leave blank if unknown — workers will be told to apply through the portal
review.noListingsHint: Create a listing to start receiving applications from workers in your district.
review.fitNote: Fit compares only the trade, district and state the worker entered on their profile. It is not a rating of the worker — read the application before deciding.
review.phoneNotShared: Phone not shared — contact them through this office
review.shortlistNote: Shortlisting only records that this office read the application. It is not an offer of work.

employers.title: Recurring employers
employers.intro: Keep a private list of the employers you work for often. Only you can see it, and the totals come from your own wage diary.
employers.name: Employer name
employers.duplicate: This employer is already in your list.
employers.empty: No employers saved yet. Add one to track your work and unpaid wages.
employers.selfReported: You entered this yourself — ShramSetu has not verified it with the employer.

requests.title: House requests
requests.intro: Households near you need your trade. Browsing is anonymous — your number is shared only if you accept.
requests.gatePending: Your registration is pending government acceptance, so you can read these offers but not accept them yet. Once a labour office accepts you, this unlocks.
requests.nearbyEmpty: No open house requests near you right now. Check back later.
requests.acceptHint: Accepting opens BOTH sides' numbers to each other. Expect a call or SMS from the household.
requests.acceptedReveal: Accepted! The requester's number is now visible below, and they can see yours. Call them to confirm the work.
requests.safetyNote: Safety: meet in public where possible, agree the day's rate before starting, and report problems through Grievances.

citizen.title: Household
citizen.heading: ShramSetu Household
citizen.tagline: Find a verified worker near you — sign in to see their number and call
citizen.recoveryBody: Shown only once — it recovers this account if you lose your phone number.
citizen.savedKey: I saved my recovery key — continue to OTP
citizen.privacyNote: This is not a worker account: no labour-office approval is needed. Signing in shows you nearby workers' contact numbers; posting a request still lets a worker call you back.
citizen.postHint: Tell the trade, what, where and when — a matching worker accepts, then you call.
citizen.describeWork: What needs doing? (e.g. two days of help replacing tiles on the veranda)
citizen.phoneGate: 🔒 Your number only reaches the worker who ACCEPTS your request — and theirs to you.
citizen.requestPosted: Request posted. Workers near you will see it in their app.
citizen.doneHint: Marked done. If the work went well, you can rate the worker publicly in the directory below.
citizen.noRequestsHint: Post one above and matching workers near you will be notified in their app.
citizen.noWorkersHint: Only government-accepted workers are listed in the directory. You can still post a request above.
citizen.directoryNote: Contact numbers are shown to your signed-in household account so you can call about work. Use them only for that.

offline.offline: You are offline. New entries are saved on this phone.

idCard.title: Worker ID card
idCard.subtitle: Your identity card for employers and labour-office checks. Print it, or save it as a PDF.
idCard.loadFailed: Could not load your ID card.
idCard.notIssuedTitle: This card is not issued yet
idCard.notIssuedBody: A labour-office official must accept your registration before the card can be verified. You can print it, but the QR will not verify until then.
idCard.name: Name
idCard.footer: This card confirms a registration accepted by a labour office. It is not a background check. Anyone can verify it by scanning the QR code.

verify.title: Check a worker card
verify.validTitle: This is a verified worker card
verify.validBody: ShramSetu issued this card and a labour office accepted the registration.
verify.notice: This confirms the registration and its acceptance. It is not a background check, and it says nothing about a specific employer or wage.
verify.malformedTitle: This is not a ShramSetu card code
verify.malformedBody: The link looks incomplete. Scan the QR code on the card again instead of typing it.
verify.invalidTitle: This card could not be verified
verify.invalidBody: No accepted, active registration matches this card. It may be a copy, an old card, or a registration that was rejected.
verify.errorBody: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
